purpose: One and only one differentiable FP64 scalar generates all weights of a 2->16->16->1 MLP through deterministic Mirror/nonlinearity recursion; teacher alignment and off-family generalization separated.

architecture.generator: analytic sinusoidal lift -> four 2-channel cyclic-permutation/Givens Mirror sandwiches with tanh and fixed analytic bias -> 337 virtual coefficients -> two hidden tanh layers
architecture.generator_coefficients: fixed in source; no learned/non-source persistent address bank
architecture.inference_checkpoint: torch.save({architecture metadata, state_dict}) in-memory; all source generator code is external and must additionally be accounted
architecture.gauge_null: linear_view cancels exactly to spectral because Q^-1(Qz)=z

data.input: each x_j uniform [-2,2], two independent streams per world and seed
data.aligned: teacher uses exactly same Mirror generator architecture and independent fixed scalar s_star=0.15+0.45*sin(world*0.93+seed*0.51); this is deliberately aligned and does not establish generality
data.train_rng: generator world*299+seed*17+1357 for minibatch index draws

optimization.dense_init: copy all virtual Mirror weights at scalar 0.2, then train all 337 elements independently
optimization.selection: LR was compared at .005,.03,.1 on DEVELOPMENT world only for 500 steps, fixed .03 before opening fresh; do not adjust from fresh

comparator_credits.spectral: one scalar analytic spectral lift no Mirror/nonlinear generator
comparator_credits.linear_view: invertible linear Mirror gauge with no activation, identical to spectral
comparator_credits.scalar_gain: one learned scalar times fixed seeded virtual vector
comparator_credits.dense: 337-parameter unrestricted identically shaped MLP; same initialization as Mirror candidate

metrics.primary: held-out MSE and R2 per world/seed/task
metrics.counts: inference code/generator program source byte sizes reported separately from tensor checkpoint
metrics.learning_gate_aligned: Mirror R2 >=0.99 in >=5/6 fresh world x seed evaluations
metrics.generalization_gate_off_family: Mirror R2>=0.95 and within 0.05 of dense R2 in >=4/6 evaluations
metrics.mirror_specific_claim: Even an aligned task success cannot establish superiority over non-Mirror alternatives on arbitrary targets
metrics.fairness_limits: unequal inference compute and tensor storage between 1-scalar and dense; output quality and times compared, not a matched-compute Pareto conclusion

environment.hardware: AMD EPYC 9V74 virtual CPU, no CUDA

boundaries: One scalar has Jacobian rank at most 1 for generated weights where differentiable
FP46/FP8000/FP80000 gradients not executed in this pilot
No independent degrees of freedom multiplier claim
Source-code constants and procedural generator cannot be treated as free storage in deployment
